overview: This House resolution assigns Representative Menefee to the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, the panel that oversees federal science agencies, NASA, and research policy. It also sets his seniority on that committee, placing him immediately after Representative Riley of New York. Committee assignments like this are a routine part of how the House organizes its work, since most bills are first reviewed by committees. The House agreed to the resolution on February 10, 2026.
for: Supporters say filling committee seats lets every member take part in reviewing legislation and gives the member's constituents a voice on science and technology policy.
against: Critics say this is a routine internal housekeeping step that changes no law or spending, so there is little to debate beyond the House's ordinary seniority process.
